comments.author: hotboxuzi
comments.body:
I guess for me, even as an AI game dev, I wouldnt spend my time or money on a game that took 20 minutes to make.   At least for now, theyre unavoidably flat, assets they pull and meshes/materials they apply typically lack depth and actual texture.    

I know the tech is advancing, but if im being honest, I still dont see it being practical to use for the full pipeline for at least another 5 years.  Some base asset generation sure, code, smaller stuff.  But when it comes to putting it all together, I feel like thats where it fumbles
